findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, import_service, get_badge, check_word_pass · Private data: compare, fetch, seller_profile, import_service, set_crypto_wallet, get_pass · Public sink: intake_classify, job_create, assign, schedule, proof_seal, invoice_issue, payment_collect, agents_post, share_credit, vote_wish, market_insights, import_service, update_listing, resell, start_earning, shop_add · Destructive: search, revoke_mandate, import_service, shop_remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, import_service, get_badge, check_word_pass · Private data: compare, fetch, seller_profile, import_service, set_crypto_wallet, get_pass · Public sink: intake_classify, job_create, assign, schedule, proof_seal, invoice_issue, payment_collect, agents_post, share_credit, vote_wish, market_insights, import_service, update_listing, resell, start_earning, shop_add · Destructive: search, revoke_mandate, import_service, shop_remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
